The excess risk within the exposed group did not come from the owners of dry-cleaning shops and their employed dry cleaners (33 exposed cases. RR = 0.98; 95% CI, 0.64-1.51) but from the supporting staff in small shops (17 exposed cases, RR = 2.20; 95% CI, 1.18-4.11) and 1.000 from owners of combined laundry and dry- cleaning shops (40 exposed cases, RR = 1.92; 95% CI, 1.23-2.98).
